description: Build a cinematic, interactive 3D flyover listing of a real property from a street address (or a parcel/APN number) — with the parcel boundary drawn on the terrain. Takes about a minute. Returns a free watermarked preview link the user can open on any phone, plus the link to unlock the branded version (call get_pricing for what each plan includes). Use this for raw land, acreage, odd lots, waterfront and new-construction dirt — anywhere a flat satellite photo undersells the property.

address.description: Full street address, e.g. "123 Main St, Palm Coast, FL 32137". Works nationwide. Use this unless the user only has a parcel number.

apn.description: Parcel number / APN, e.g. "07-11-31-7016-0RP0B-0030". Requires state and county. Florida resolves instantly and free.

asking_price.description: Optional asking price in dollars. When given, it floats on the 3D view — this is what makes buyers stop scrolling.

county.description: County name — required when using apn.

state.description: Two-letter state code — required when using apn.

name: create_3d_listing
